name: Cathy Claret
description: '''Cathy Claret''' (born 1963 in [[Nîmes]], [[France]]) is a French [[singer-songwriter]], composer, producer and multi-instrumentalist based in [[Spain]] since the 1980s. Her work blends [[flamenco]] with [[pop music|pop]], [[French chanson|chanson]], [[bossa nova]] and [[Rumba flamenca|rumba]], and Spanish music press has described her as one of the pioneers in the integration of flamenco into pop songwriting. Despite a modest commercial profile in Spain, she has developed a long-standing audience in [[Japan]], a contrast that ''[[Late Motiv]]''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s host [[Andreu Buenafuente]] compared to the documentary ''[[Searching for Sugar Man]]''.
